slots_and_copies.name: slot_0
slots_and_copies.selection_rule: Single copy at SRAM 0x0E000000. No mirror/backup found: only one flush (FUN_0802b904, decompiled.c:1352) and bytes 0x2c08-0x7fff stay 0xff in both samples. Validity decided by FUN_0802b7ec: returns 0=valid, 1=20-byte header mismatch, 2=field-range failure; callers treat non-zero as no-save/defaults.

checksums.name: none_found_write_verify_only
checksums.formula_detail: No sum/XOR/CRC/complement is computed over save data anywhere in the 91-function corpus. Integrity = (1) FUN_08032a38 write-with-verify: FUN_08032964 byte-copy src->SRAM then FUN_080329d4 verify-copy/compare, retried up to 3 times (decompiled.c:2731-2746); (2) FUN_0802b7ec 20-byte header compare + field range checks on load. Brute-force Python check (see report Sec.4): sum8/sum16/sum32/xor8/crc16/crc32 over [0,0x2c08) of cap-01 = 0x0e/0x0b0e/0x00080b0e/0xb2/0xf30a/0x0e4a5471, none of which appears stored anywhere in the file; same negative result for cap-00 and for sub-ranges [0,0x2268),[0,0x1368).

verified_on_samples.computed_hex: all-0xff blank; sum16=0xdbf8 crc32=0x19f184cd (over [0,0x2c08)); no stored match

open_questions: Absolute SRAM offsets of FUN_0802b7ec's u16 (<0x2f) / clamped u32 fields and FUN_0802bf6c's u16 (0-5): Ghidra left them as unresolved _DAT/uRam globals; ROM literal-pool values are not in the workspace, so they are reported UNKNOWN rather than guessed.

Exact flush length literal _DAT_0802badc and EWRAM-clear length _DAT_0802baa8: sav 0xff boundary at 0x2c08 proves at least/exactly 11272 bytes written in practice, but the literal itself is unresolved.

Semantics of Tables A/B/C and header byte 0x0a: only one populated (factory-fresh) sample exists and cap-00 is fully erased, so no gameplay-mutated diff is available; names are structural, not semantic.

FUN_0802be98 and FUN_08026254 (validator helpers) and FUN_08032a7c (copy/compare core) are not among the 91 decompiled functions; validator return-2 checks and verify-compare semantics are static-only.
Whether the 20-byte ROM template compared by FUN_0802b7ec equals sav[0:20] cannot be verified without ROM bytes; verified_in_code=false for the magic signature for this reason.
No paired .ss save states exist (states/ is empty, PACKET cold-reload probe errored), so all fuzzing predictions are untested.
